glosses: To expose to the weather, or show the effects of such exposure, or to withstand such effects.

examples.text: "Come hither! come hither! my little daughter, / And do not tremble so; / For I can weather the roughest gale, That ever wind did blow."

examples.text: Joshua weathered a collision with a freighter near South Africa.
